description: This Java class defines an exception type for illegal number arguments within the Apache Commons Math3 library, serving as a base class for more specific exceptions related to numerical argument violations.

classes.name: MathIllegalNumberException
classes.description: Base class for exceptions raised due to invalid number arguments, providing storage for the problematic argument and a constructor for creating exception instances with a pattern and arguments.

methods.name: MathIllegalNumberException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a pattern, the wrong number, and optional arguments.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Returns the number argument that caused the exception.
